We need to move fast on a recovery plan. I need each of you -- Logistics, Export Compliance, Packaging Engineering, and Customer Fulfillment -- to submit your relevant constraint as a formal huddle-record entry. Please don't just tell me informally; I need it in the recorded round-robin format so I can sign off on the plan. Let's get started. What constraints do each of you need to flag?
